title: Native own-target Mareep height reader rejects a restored wrong-Y read
expectationSource: Requirement shared.spawn-height-recorder-control-v1: preserve one naturally spawned Wild Mareep's own initial landing target through its complete Appear Hop. At that exact target require coherent loaded metatile permission, exclusion of authored surfaces, actual successful native height refresh and matching terminal Y. Bind all native receipts and terrain/model provenance to this encounter, object and world. Missing data is unknown, not legal. This does not prove universal unmodeled geometry, later movement or chain actions.
